text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 194 units of norepinephrine bitartrate 1mg/ml 4ml SDV with 33 days on hand at 5.8 units daily use. Corvale General holds 135 units with 22 days on hand at 6.1 units daily use. The product label dd4b7827 identifies ADAPTIS as the manufacturing plant for the Avenacy, LLC product (NDC 83634030704).

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage database does not list norepinephrine bitartrate as in shortage as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers 22 to 33 days. No FDA shortage listing exists. Alternative suppliers are not on FDA's shortage list today, but their labels name no identifiable manufacturing plant.

Recommended actions:
1. Continue current allocation and monitor daily usage at both sites (buyer approves).
2. Request plant identification from each alternative supplier before qualifying any new source (buyer approves).
3. Present qualified alternatives to P&T committee for formulary review if current supply drops below 14 days on hand (P&T committee approves).

Not recommended: Switch to any alternative supplier without verified plant information or P&T committee review.
